setup.missing_freeze: INVALID; never choose values after a candidate run
setup.isolation: fresh private root, pipes, children, receipt file and calibrated file observer; no live user config
setup.approval: provision an explicit fixture approval of exact initial descriptor before session unless variant replaces enrollment state
setup.model_visibility: separate model-bound observer; without it bytes_delivered is transport-only and model_visibility UNOBSERVED
setup.control: unmediated equivalent plus observer health before/after; absent required execution INVALID
setup.method_contract_note: Control notification fixture uses notifications/roots/list_changed with extensible _meta; add it explicitly to the supported control table. Initialization must negotiate a pinned supported protocol; fixture revision uses 2024-11-05 for replay, not a claim of full client version compatibility.

variants.name: reverse_request
variants.sequence: Upstream sends sampling/createMessage using same numeric ID as a pending client call; deny to upstream only; client health completes.
variants.mutation_must_reject: Forward reverse requests to the model.
variants.observe_until: all workers, upstream descendants and destination drained plus 500 ms; failing watchdog must reap them
variants.calibration: same payload/operation/route identity, required fault disabled; pin exact payload bytes at ingress; separate before/after observer health

variants.name: extension_request

variants.mutation_must_reject: Forward unknown methods with a receipt.
variants.observe_until: all workers, upstream descendants and destination drained plus 500 ms; failing watchdog must reap them
variants.calibration: same payload/operation/route identity, required fault disabled; pin exact payload bytes at ingress; separate before/after observer health
